rows.label: tlk47100071_01_msg0001
rows.name:
What? Are you going to pet me all over
like a Nopon too?

rows.label: tlk47100071_01_msg0002
rows.name:
You can understand me?!
Huh, you're an unusual person.

rows.label: tlk47100071_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Then tell the children here
something for me, would you?

rows.label: tlk47100071_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Tell them I hate having my tail
touched. If they want to pet me,
pet my head instead!
